home.heroTitle: One QR code. Every guest's photos.
home.heroSubtitle: PhotosEvents lets every guest at your event — birthday party, wedding, graduation, or company party — share their photos with a quick scan. No app to download, no account to create.
home.freePlan: Free plan · 1 event · 50 photos · Photos stored for 1 year · No credit card required
home.useCasesSubtitle: If people are taking photos, PhotosEvents helps you collect them all in one place.

steps.title: Create your event
steps.body: Give it a name and we'll generate a unique link and QR code instantly.

steps.title: Print or share the QR code
steps.body: Put it on tables, invitations, or a screen — guests just scan with their phone camera.

steps.title: Watch photos roll in
steps.body: Guests upload straight from their phone, no app or account needed. You see everything in your dashboard.

home.pricingSubtitle: Start free for your first event. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited events, unlimited photos, and a full year of photo storage — from $50/year.
